title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Navigate the vertical campus of Hunter College with these ten distinct study environments, from silent library basements to sunlit lounges and specialized research centers.

cards.title: Silent Reading Room
cards.subtitle: East Building Basement Level 2
cards.notes: Head to the lowest level of the library for a strictly silent environment. This floor features individual cubicles and desks designed for deep focus without distractions.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent study floor located in the second basement level of the Cooperman Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cooperman Library has designated floors B1 and B2 as completely silent study areas with no talking or phone conversations permitted.
cards.source_title: Group Study-Noise Policy - Hunter College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; requires a valid Hunter College ID for entry to the East Building.

cards.title: Tech-Enabled Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: East Building Floor 5
cards.notes: Reserve one of the six newly renovated rooms (520-525) for up to two hours. These spaces include wireless display monitors for collaborative digital work.
cards.short_summary: Renovated reservable group study rooms equipped with wireless monitors on the library's 5th floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Rooms 520, 521, 522, 523, 524, and 525 are available for reservation and equipped with display monitors for wireless device connection.
cards.source_title: 5th Floor Study Rooms Available for Reservations - Hunter College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via the online system; keys must be picked up from the 3rd-floor circulation desk.

cards.title: The 16th Floor Retreat
cards.subtitle: North Building Room 1608
cards.notes: Take the A5 elevator to the 16th floor for a specialized study space. It offers silent study areas, color printing, and a collection of art history reference works.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library on the 16th floor of the North Building offering silent study and art resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Zabar Art Library includes silent study areas, outlets, charging stations, and laptops for check-out on the 16th floor of the North Building.
cards.source_title: Zabar Art Library - Hunter College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Accessible via North Building A5 elevator; check specific library hours for 16th-floor access.

cards.title: 7th Floor Social Study
cards.subtitle: West Building Floor 7
cards.notes: Located across from Room 714, this lounge provides a space for 'talking study.' It is ideal for students who need to participate in online classes with headphones.
cards.short_summary: A designated 'Talking Study Space' in the West Building for students attending online classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sidney Miller Lounge on the 7th floor of the West Building is a dedicated student Talking Space for taking online courses.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: Historic Policy Study
cards.subtitle: Roosevelt House Floor 2
cards.notes: Study in the former personal library of Sara Delano Roosevelt. This historic space is open to students taking public policy or human rights courses at the institute.
cards.short_summary: A historic student study center located within the Roosevelt House Public Policy Institute.
cards.evidence_claim: The SDR Library serves as a student study center for students taking classes at Roosevelt House in public policy and human rights courses.
cards.source_title: Sara Delano Roosevelt Library - Roosevelt House
cards.access_notes: Located at 47-49 East 65th Street; primarily for students enrolled in Roosevelt House programs.

cards.title: Outdoor Lexington View
cards.subtitle: West Building Floor 3
cards.notes: Escape the indoors at this 3rd-floor patio located within the cafeteria. It features tables and chairs with views of Lexington Avenue, perfect for fair-weather studying.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor patio space attached to the West Building cafeteria for studying and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Building terrace offers a spacious reprieve with tables and chairs, ideal for studying or eating with a view of Lexington Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the 3rd-floor cafeteria; weather permitting.

cards.title: Social Work Study Hub
cards.subtitle: Silberman Building Floor 1
cards.notes: Visit the East Harlem campus for a change of pace. This library offers four reservable group study rooms and dedicated silent study areas for focused work.
cards.short_summary: The main reading room and study area for the Social Work & Urban Public Health Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has four reservable group study rooms, as well as group and silent study areas, located on the main floor of the Silberman Building.
cards.source_title: Social Work & Urban Public Health Library
cards.access_notes: Located at 2180 Third Avenue (119th St); requires Hunter ID for entry.

cards.title: Quiet Stacks at Brookdale
cards.subtitle: Brookdale Campus
cards.notes: For maximum quiet, travel to the Brookdale campus. The library stacks are known among students for being less crowded and very silent compared to the main 68th St campus.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area located within the Health Professions Library at the Brookdale Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Health Professions Library at the Brookdale campus offers quiet study spaces and is often cited by students as a quieter alternative to the main campus.
cards.source_title: Health Professions Library - Hunter College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located at 425 East 25th Street; requires Hunter ID for entry.

cards.title: Escalator-Adjacent Lounges
cards.subtitle: West Building Floors 3-7
cards.notes: Utilize the renovated 'touch down' spaces located next to the escalators on floors 3 through 7. Each floor features different seating arrangements for quick study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Renovated student lounges located on multiple floors of the West Building for study and socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: Newly renovated lounges are available on every floor of the West Building (3-7), featuring seating conducive to both quiet study and socializing.
cards.access_notes: Open access for students during building hours; no reservation required.

cards.title: Academic Support Hub
cards.subtitle: East Building Floor 7
cards.notes: Study in the heart of academic support. This 7th-floor library space houses the Writing, Math, and Science learning centers, offering a productive, resource-rich environment.
cards.short_summary: A centralized academic support and study area on the 7th floor of the Cooperman Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Silverstein Student Success Center on the 7th floor of the Cooperman Library houses the Writing, Math, and Science Learning Centers.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the library's 7th-floor entrance; check center-specific hours for tutoring services.
